## Overview

LRP-CA-005 extends the **concurrent conditional-associations** family (#336, descriptive-association workstream #314) to **standardised receptive vocabulary** (ROWPVT, `R`) as the focal outcome. At each timepoint (t1–t4) it fits a between-child Beta-Binomial regression of receptive vocabulary's level on the standardised same-wave logits of the other core skills — word reading (`W`), letter sounds (`L`), blending (`B`), taught receptive (`TR`) and expressive (`TE`) vocabulary, and standardised expressive vocabulary (`E`) — plus age and a group nuisance term. The four waves are fitted separately and reported side by side.

The family's core skill set is {`W`, `L`, `B`, `TR`, `TE`, `R`, `E`}: each model conditions its focal outcome on the remaining six, so the models describe complementary full conditionals of the same measure set. The estimand is the mutually-adjusted association at each wave: *"at wave t, among children alike on age and the other skills, +n of a predictor skill is associated with +m more receptive-vocabulary items"*. `R` is a 170-item standardised transfer measure and does not have the late-wave ceiling compression flagged for the 24-item `TR` focal. All children are on the intervention from t2, so these associations describe the skill measures within a treated system.

_Estimand: descriptive association (no causal warrant)._ Every coefficient is an **adjusted association**. Conditioning on contemporaneous (post-treatment) skill levels is intentional and licensed *because nothing here is read causally*. Read the results with the Table-2-fallacy, measurement-error and collinearity/regularisation caveats set out in the Results section.
